title: Diagnostics in Diverticulitis (DIDit)
brief_summary: This study focuses on if low dose CT without intravenous contrast has a high enough specificity and sensitivity for acute diverticulitis that it can be used as the primary diagnostic method instead of a full dose CT with intravenous contrast which is the standard method in Sweden.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Over the age of 50
* Clinically suspected acute diverticulitis
* Low abdominal pain
* WBC over 10 x 109/L or raised C-reactive protein levels 25 mg/L

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
* Previous allergy to intravenous contrast
* Renal failure or other reasons that the patient cannot undergo CT with iv contrast
* Unable to give informed consent
* Dementia
* Language barrier
